text: ここには　けっかいを　はってある　やすんで　いくが　よい！

structure.jp: ここには　けっかいを　はってある
structure.en: a protective barrier has been set up here

structure.jp: やすんで　いくが　よい！
structure.en: you may rest and then go!

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did it on purpose and it is still in place. はってある = 'has been set up (and is there)'.

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus がいい is a lordly way of telling someone to go ahead and do it; よい is the older form of いい. いくが よい = 'you may go, do so'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb here means doing it first and then going on your way. やすんで いく = 'rest before you go'.
